    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    CockroachHarness
    A CockroachDB test harness with two backends: container — spins up an ephemeral single-node CockroachDB via Testcontainers (CockroachHarness.container()).
    ConcurrencyResult
    Aggregate outcome of a ConcurrencyRunner.run(ConcurrencyRunner.ConcurrentTask) execution.
    ConcurrencyRunner
    Spawns multiple threads that execute a task concurrently, releasing them from a common barrier to maximize contention.
    ConcurrencyRunner.ConcurrentTask
    A unit of concurrent work identified by worker and iteration index.
    RetrySimulator
    Simulates CockroachDB serialization failures for a configurable number of attempts, then succeeds.
    SerializationConflicts
    Ready-made workloads that reliably provoke CockroachDB serialization conflicts (SQLSTATE 40001) for use with ConcurrencyRunner.
    SimulatedRetryException
    A SQLException carrying SQLSTATE 40001 (serialization failure), mimicking CockroachDB's retryable transaction-conflict error.
